notes.title: 📢 Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
[p align="start"]I want to let you know about a change to the release schedule of Courier Life Simulator. The game was originally set to release on September 25, but as a solo developer with a full-time job, I simply don’t have enough time to finish everything properly by then.
[p align="start"]The new release date will be October 20th. This will still be an Early Access launch, but with the extra time I’ll be able to add more features that were originally planned for later in Early Access—so the game will arrive with more content from day one.
[p align="start"]I’m truly sorry for this delay, and I promise this won’t happen again. Thank you so much for your patience and support—it really keeps me motivated. 🙏
[p align="start"]As a bonus, I’ll be uploading a new version of the demo next week, so you can try out the improvements before launch.
[p align="start"]Thanks again for understanding, and I can’t wait for you to experience Courier Life Simulator soon!

notes.title: Demo UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
[p align="start"]First of all, we want to thank you for taking the time to try out the demo of Courier Life Simulator and for sharing your feedback with us. We’ve heard your concerns, and we want to address them openly.
[p align="start"]We recognize that the demo in its current form feels less polished than we would like—especially in terms of graphics and overall presentation. Visual elements like shadows and certain details were not at the level we are aiming for, and we truly apologize for that.


[p align="start"]That being said, we want to assure you that we are actively working on a more polished demo. This upcoming version will include significant graphical improvements, including better lighting and shadows, as well as a generally more refined visual style to better reflect our vision for the final game.
[p align="start"]We’re committed to making Courier Life Simulator the best it can be, and your support and feedback mean a lot to us. Stay tuned for updates—we can’t wait to show you the improved demo soon!
[p align="start"]Thank you,
The Courier Life Simulator Team Cyber Mode Software 🚚
